title: Antipodal Segments and Simplices
summary: Is the size of a pairwise antipodal family of segments or $`k`$-simplices in $`\mathbb R^d`$ at most $`2^{d-k}`$?

title: Points in a Centrally Symmetric Convex Body
summary: Does every centrally symmetric convex body in dimension $`n\ge3`$ contain $`2n`$ points at pairwise distance at least $`\sqrt2`$ in its own norm?

title: Faces of a Compact Convex Set
summary: Can every point of a compact convex set be represented using faces with prescribed individual dimension bounds?

title: Planks Covering the Unit Ball
summary: How much of the unit ball can be covered by planks whose total width is less than its diameter?

title: Simplex–Ball Intersection in Spherical and Hyperbolic Space
summary: In spherical or hyperbolic space, does a concentric regular simplex maximize intersection with a fixed ball among simplices of a fixed volume?

title: Covering a Unit Cube by Smaller Cubes
summary: How many cubes of edge length strictly less than one are needed to cover a unit cube when rotations are allowed?

title: Volume of the Boolean Quadric Polytope
summary: Find an exact volume formula, or improved bounds, for the Boolean quadric polytope of the complete graph.

title: Triangulations of Perturbed Square Grids
summary: Does every tetrahedralization of a small three-dimensional perturbation of an $`n`$-point planar square grid have $`O(n^{3/2})`$ cells?

title: Incenter on the Euler Line of an n-Simplex
summary: Characterize higher-dimensional simplices whose incenter lies on the line through the circumcenter and centroid.

title: Euclidean, Gram, and Positive Semidefinite Corank Graph Parameters
summary: Do Euclidean dimension, Gram dimension, and positive semidefinite corank satisfy the proposed universal equalities for graphs?

title: A Multicolored Carathéodory Conjecture
summary: Can an origin-containing transversal also have distinct row labels within every color class?

title: Howard's Policy Iteration Complexity for Deterministic MDPs
summary: Is synchronous Howard policy iteration strongly polynomial for deterministic discounted Markov decision processes with an input discount factor?

title: Strategy Iteration Complexity for Deterministic Turn-Based Zero-Sum Games
summary: Is simple strategy iteration polynomial, or strongly polynomial, for deterministic turn-based zero-sum discounted games?

title: Interior-Point Algorithms for Discounted Markov Games
summary: Can a leader-based interior-point algorithm solve discounted Markov games with only logarithmic dependence on the inverse discount gap?

title: Strongly Polynomial Algorithm for General Discounted MDPs
summary: Is there a strongly polynomial exact algorithm for general discounted Markov decision processes when the discount factor is part of the input?

title: Markov Decision Processes with an Input Discount Factor
summary: Can discounted Markov decision processes with an input discount factor be solved exactly with only logarithmic discount-gap dependence in the arithmetic-operation count?
